articleTitle: Cloud Computing-based Data Storage and Disaster Recovery
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: To solve the problems of business database services such as storage capacity, performance, stability, security, load, and many other issues, cloud storage was used to provide the cloud-based data platform. Data services were put on the cloud, and the powerful operating system and platform were used to process data. This article describes the architecture of cloud storage and presents the deployment of the disaster recovery and other applications in inter-private cloud storage, which can achieve a true cloud computing.

articleTitle: The Present Situation and Development Trend of E-sports Games in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By using the method of literature and journalism collection, this paper makes an investigation and analysis of the E-sports games in China and attempts to prospect the trend of it's development. The conclusion is that the E-ports games can propel the sports industry forward and lead the traditional entertainment into a new developing stage. Now China E-sports is still in development stage, the market is still in a spontaneous and disorderly state as Government don't take it seriously. Therefore, the urgent matter of the moment is how to standardize them reasonably and guide the E-sports and relevant industries to a healthy development.

articleTitle: Study on Cultural Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: A Cultural Algorithm (CA) rooting from simulation of evolution of human being society, provides a new computable framework of Evolution Algorithms. Concept of CA is more easily understood and more accuracy to reflect evolution process of society than some other optimization algorithms. CA has been successfully applied to much engineering. Firstly, this paper depicts natural explanation about CA. Secondly, introduces its basic theory. At last, the paper also tests it using 9 examples with nonlinear constrained optimization. The results show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Design of Coal Mine Gas Monitoring System Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Wireless sensor networks have become one of the important research fields. It has a wide-range application background. This paper through to the research of wireless sensor network development present situation and the tendency, the coal mine gas wireless monitor present situation, the ZigBee technology, proposed a wireless sensor network monitor system solution based on the ZigBee technology, which face to the coal mine gas wireless monitor application. analyzed the system design goal, the function and the performance index, pointed out the system design feasibility and the software and hardware platform design request and the principle of design. The overall system take the wireless sensor networking technology as a core, strengthened the system flexibility, the maintainability and the extendibility, meanwhile the system modulation and the open style structure enable the system to have a good probability. The system raises the mine safety production level and the safety in production management efficiency, and also builds the good foundation for further study and the practical application from now on.

articleTitle: The Adaptive On-line Exam System Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the development and popularization of the Internet/intranet technology, computerized tests will gradually replace traditional paper and pen-based tests on many aspects. It has particular practical significance to explore and study computer network-based tests to objectively and accurately evaluate certain abilities and levels of students to improve the learning efficiency. Agent is a software entity with adaptability and intelligence, thus it can represent the user or other programs to finish a set of work by the means of initiative service. Usage of the Agent technology can add interesting and humanized features to the network tests, reduce network flow, improve testing effectiveness and increase testing quality. By using the Agent technology and building the model of an adaptive network testing system, this paper realizes the exchange and sharing of knowledge among various Agents and personalized tests for students, and it also increases the response speed of the network testing system. In this way, it has improved the shortages of traditional computer adaptive testing system. Research in this paper has important significance to strengthening the intelligence and adaptability of network tests, reduce network flow and improve the effectiveness and quality of network tests.

articleTitle: Study on Application and Biosafety of Nano-materials in Sports Engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Objective: to elucidate the application and biosafety of nanomaterials in sports engineering. Methods: literature and experts interview. Results: nanomaterials have widely been applied in sports engineering, such as sports stadium and gymnasium, sports turf, running track, sports clothing, sports equipment and nutrition supplement. Inevitably, nanomaterials may cause some potential adverse effects on the cell, lung, liver, kidney, and brain, respectively. Conclusion: nanmaterials have been fully used in sports fields, and its biosafety should also be focused.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Feedback System for Bicycle Pedaling Technique and its Application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This diagnosis and feedback system for bicycle pedaling technique has been designed with VF 6.0. This system includes 5 modules which are 2-D image analysis, dynamics parameters collection, data analysis, parameters assessment, and athletes data. 2-D image analysis has been developed to suit for the characteristics of the pedaling technique. Through dynamics parameters collection, 2-D or 3-D forces of the pedals, handlebars, and saddle can be obtained. Kinematics and dynamics parameter can be obtained and be stored into the database of the diagnosis system concurrently. User can obtain an athlete data or more to analyze and compare them, and can compare between common athletes and elite athletes or among elite athletes. This system is easy to use, especial for the coaches. This system integrates data collection, analysis, and store.

articleTitle: Application Research of Video Annotation in Sports Video Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Based on well-defined semantics events in sport video, using the annotation method of manual entry to bridge the gap that between the low-level features and the semantics event in sports video. To solve the problems caused by separation of semantic description and video file, this dissertation proposes an approach for the information embedded in different video formats and gives the specific process using standard AVI file as an example. As a result of the annotation process, the new video could apply to applications such as sports video analysis, statistical analysis of technical and tactical and contribute to the improvement of technical and tactical of the players.

articleTitle: Analysis on Assessment Indices of Take-off Techniques in Long Jump
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The main methods I used are documentation method, shooting and kinetic Biomechanics analysis method. And in the study I offer the take-off effect index in order to diagnose the take-off leg effect by considering training practice and drafts center of mass ascent angle index in takeoff support period, and did research on the two new indices definition and application. This papers provides reference for accurately diagnosing our country's long jump technique, perfecting training plan and improving jumpers' performances.

articleTitle: Smart Sportswear
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Smart sportswear has been widely used in professional sports, while the technology is still in development. This article illustrates the main working principles of e-sportswear and offers a glimpse at some of its manufacturers for the present, offering some information about the challenges this industry is facing.

articleTitle: The Discussion on Improvement of the J2EE Framework Based on SSH
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: SSH is a development mode which is widely used in current enterprise's development. In order to make the project development more efficient, with the online fund trade platform for example, this paper deeply discusses the problems of distributing Action and Hibernate's lazy loading in actual development with SSH mode, and puts forward the improvement project, which greatly increases the development efficiency.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of the Hydrodynamic Performance of an Oar Blade of Canoe
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This In present report, the flow around an oar blade of Canoe which was used in sports competition in full scale was simulated using Fluent, commercial software, for the computation of fluid dynamics (CFD). The numerical results of total drag values in difference a span of angles of attack in flume were obtained. The results of drag obtained from Fluent were compared with the results acquried from experiments. The validities of the six turbulence models in Fluent were carried out to predict the three-dimensional viscous flows and the hydrodynamic performance of a blade of canoe, and the Spalart - Allmaras (S-A) model, SST k - ω (sstkw) mode, standard k - ε (ske) model and realization k - ε (rke) model, which were found, were better model using to model the flow of a blade of canoe during the stroke. Therefore, these turbulent models will be used to the model to optimal the shape design of the blade, and be very useful in the research of the hydrodynamic performance of interference of multi-oars.

articleTitle: A New Kind of Hybrid Cache Coherence Protocol for Multiprocessor with D-Cache
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper introduces a new kind of hybrid Cache coherence protocol-MECSIF, which applicants for multiprocessor environment, based on hybrid cache line write strategy. Through the introduction of a small dictionary-D-Cache in system architecture, protocol overcomes the shortcoming of snoopy coherence protocol that data request was undifferentiated broadcasted. Protocol extends data block state so that eliminates "ping-pang" phenomenon, uses hybrid cache line write strategy to reduce L1 cache miss ratio. Simulation results show that the MECSIF protocol extent improves the efficiency of processor data access comparing with MESI protocol.

articleTitle: Surface Effects on Plantar Pressure Characteristics in Jogging
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The purpose of this study was to explore the effect of three common sports surfaces on plantar pressure characteristics and performance of impact in lower extremity during jogging. Methods: Medilogic insole plantar pressure system® was utilized to collect plantar pressure data (including contact time, peak pressure, pressure-time integral) and pressure distribution during touch-down and toe-off phases. Grass surface, rubber running track, and concrete surface were chosen as testing surfaces. Results: During touchdown, the first peak pressure (time) and pressure-time integral within first peak period of running on the concrete were significantly greater (or earlier) than the other two. However, the pressure distribution of all insole areas (forefoot, mid-foot, heel, lateral, and medial) were similar among the three types of sports surfaces both in touch-down and toe-off. Conclusion: Surfaces with less or no cushioning would lead to a higher risk of sports injury during long-term jogging. However, the further effect of different surfaces on pressure distribution and the influence it may bring subsequently was not as distinct as expected.

articleTitle: Time-varying Sliding Mode Control in Hysteresis Compensation of the Piezoceramic Actuators Based on the Inverse Preisach Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to reduce the hysteresis characteristics of the piezoceramic actuators, an exponential time-varying sliding mode controller based on inverse compensation was proposed in this paper. Firstly, an inverse preisach model of the hysteresis was achieved to reduce the impact of the hysteresis. However, the hysteresis can't be entirely offset by the inverse model, and there are also many uncertainties in the system. So an exponential time-varying sliding mode controller which is global robust against external disturbances and system uncertainties is designed. The experiment results show that the proposed control strategy improves the tracking accuracy of the system. And compared with the conventional sliding mode control, the proposed control strategy can smoothly track the input signal in the initial stage, and eliminates the reaching phase of time invariant sliding mode control.

articleTitle: Consonant Passwords in the Fingers (1)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Language has interactive and random characteristics, someone had said that the language could not be located. We intend to solve the problem: the location of the Chinese Alphabetic Passwords in the Fingers. The Chinese Alphabet consists of 33 letters and 4 phonetic symbols, has 1383 kinds of combined patterns. These 33 letters are divided into 7 vowels and 26 consonants. The core of Chinese Alphabet is the vowels and vowels group, they have a few quantity but change more and decide the running laws of a Chinese word, The consonants lie in a subordinate status, they have a large quantity but change rarely and obey the vowels running laws. In this article we only discuss the positions of 11 consonant passwords in the fingers.

articleTitle: China's Guangxi and Vietnam Laos and Cambodia in Stadiums Investment Cooperation Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: China's Guangxi and Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia build a new platform in tourism, culture, sports industry for trade and investment exchanges and cooperation. With the methods of literature research, statistics method, tracking surveys and other research methods, this paper analyzes the status of China's Guangxi to Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia in investment and construction of stadiums. Draw a conclusion: Expanding enterprise development space and expanding market share have gained access to the breakthrough, Building a modern stadium and sports facilities of science configuration have promoted investment and cooperation success in building stadiums, and have effectively promoted the development of regional sports industry.

articleTitle: The Boosting Role of Production, Study and Research Alliance in the Development of Sports Material Discipline
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper introduces the development course of Sports Material discipline of East China University of Science and Technology, the cases of production, study and research alliance, industrialization achievements, discipline layout and management and operation mechanism of R&D center of sports material, expounds emphatically how to disinter new growth point of discipline and construction of technical platform for sports equipment development by key technology research and technology integration innovation.

articleTitle: Construction of the Practical Teaching System for the Undergraduate of Sports Equipment Engineering Specialty
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In this paper, used literature search, investigation methods and so on, summarizes and analyses the structure, contents, styles and effects of the practice teaching system in Sports Equipment Engineering Specialty in Shenyang University of Technology. The paper especially expounds the practice teaching system in Sports Equipment Engineering Specialty. The paper studies enriching and perfecting main experiences and improvement measures in Sports Equipment Engineering Specialty in Shenyang University of Technology.

articleTitle: The Comparative Study of the Development of of Sports Tourism Project between Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia Naadam Festivals
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the basis of classification characteristics of sports tourism of Xinjiang Mongolian, this paper tries to carry out comparative analysis with the emphasis on the "Naadam" festival in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia. This paper approves that Xinjang has its merits in the development of sports tourism with Mongolian characteristics by combining the local characteristics of physical aspects while there also exists some problems. Hence this paper puts forward some strategies of the development of sports tourism project in Xinjiang Mongolian.

articleTitle: GM (1,1) Model Gray Prediction for the Gold-Medal Result of Women's Put Shot in the 30th Olympic Games
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Through the methods of document and mathematical statistics, this paper takes the gold-medal records of women's shot put in the Olympic Games from 1992 to 2008 as the raw data and uses GM(1,1) prediction model in Gray System Theory to predict the gold-medal result of women's shot put in the 2012 London Olympic Games. After the residual test, correlation test and posterior difference test, the model can predict the result accurately which is 20.0761 meters and the curve fitting result is y = 4273.836e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-0.0048k</sup> (e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.0048</sup> -1). It will provide helpful reference for the training of our athletes in the upcoming London Olympic Games to predict the gold-medal result of the women's shot put in the 30th Olympic Games.

articleTitle: Serial Communication System of Mobile Devices and Embedded Computer Based on C/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This system mainly aims at the design of communication system for autonomous mobile robot intelligent system, mobile robots can complete the function that is sensory of the outside world such as the situations and changes of surrounding environment based on multi-sensor information fusion, can identify obstacles through ultrasound and infrared sensors. Multiple control various information accessed by handling, thus understand their status and the external environment information which they are in, and makes the motion control instantaneously because the motion flexible performance of mobile robot.

articleTitle: Mechanics Analysis of Lumbar Segment for the Athlete During Preparing Lifting Barbell and It's Finite Element Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The thesis established the three-dimensional, comprehensive and realistic finite element model(FEM) of lumbar spine (L1-L5) for the Weight lifting athlete using datum of Dicom, which was used to simulate and anlyze the biomechanics of a lumbar motion segment during preparing lifting barbell. The results were following as: during preparing lifting barbell the equivalent stress on the anterior-lower location of vertebral body is higher than the rest location, stress on pedicle of vertebral arch is higher. The equivalent stress of intervertebral disc was found at middle-anterior location of exterior annulus fibrosus, especial anterior location in flexion. The equivalent stress on the vertebral body and intervertebral disc showed gradually ascending trend from up to down, the stress on the vertebral body is higher 4-5 times than the below intervertebral disc's.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Multiplayer Connection Technology on LAN in Virtual Scene
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Firstly, how to send the real-time data collected by each computer to all the computers in network for their monitoring, secondly, how to send the historical data to each computer in the whole network to ensure a consistent whole network data, In addition, how to send the command to an implementing computer, and control records of the whole network of other computers. Combining many aspects, this paper designs a virtual scene in the distributed network multiplayer system, designs an online multi-user virtual environment to achieve the mutual information and to send, receive and transmit. Under the environment of Windows XP, making use of CSocket provided by Visual C which carries on the development of applied procedure, we can make the procedure carry out receiving data on network, send out function quickly and accurately, complete data delivering of customer. The realization is under the network environment of having another person's on-line technique.

articleTitle: The Application of Information Technologyin Sports Training
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The development of information technology have pushed the development of other related industries, if the sports training system which developed by information technology combined with automatics apply in the tradition sports training, that will be promote the efficient of the training. In this context, we hammer at raise some bonding point of information technology and sports training which through lucubrate the current information technology, aiming to provide some useful information to the researchers of computer applied training system also provide some consult for the development of sports training.

articleTitle: Studies on Results of Biofeedback in Springboard Diving Training
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The purpose of this study was to determine whether biofeedback could promote the efficiency of springboard diving training. Eight athletes took part in this subject, which were divided into two groups - experimental group and contrast group. The experimental group used biofeedback techniques while the contrast group did not use, at the same time other related arrangements keep same. After three months of training, we tested various abilities of athletes. The results showed that: 1) bio-feedback technology can promote the training efficiency in springboard diving skills training. For athletes to learn new actions the use of biofeedback techniques can give great help to skill training, while for the old actions learning, the role of bio-feedback technology is not as significant as new action, but experimental group still showed better skills, 2) Through the analysis of the model, improving the stability of players is one mean of biofeedback technology to improve training efficiency, 3) the depth of the springboard is the necessary conditions for a higher height, while the cycle of takeoff has no relationship with the height.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Five-point Arithmetic for Calibrating Touch Screen Based on STC MCU
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Pointing to the deviation of touch screen in actual application, a kind of five-point calibration algorithm was presented. We designed a system with high-performance MCU as the control unit. The data, after AD converted by ADS7845, are calibrated and transmitted to the LCD display. The five-point calibration algorithm system has been used in Ethane Producer Department, Guangzhou Petrifaction Ltd, which realizes calibration error of touch screen.

articleTitle: Research Advancements of Compression Equipments in Sports Science
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The utilization of sports compression equipments has widely attracted the attention of researchers with the need to maintain muscle functions, reduce sport injuries, and improve athletic performance. It has become a heated issue in research field of sportswear since the beginning of the new century. Methods of literature review, logic analysis and mathematical statistics were used to analyze the study of compression garments from hardcopy journals and online databases. Although a series of studies showed the benefits of compression garments, however, the underlying mechanisms have not been confirmed yet. Moreover, no research referring compression equipments have been conducted in China, which also restricts our native people from getting a further understanding about the potential mechanism of compression apparel. Based on more advanced compression materials, the future study of compression garments will focus on the vibration characteristics of muscle (soft tissue), especially on proprioceptive sensation, neuromuscular control, injury prevention, and performance enhancement.

articleTitle: Sport Video Intelligence Analysis Using Mid-Level and Low-Level Vision Information
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Because of large audiences, great business prospects and potential applications, sports video has attracted academic and industry attention. From the low-level feature extraction and mid-level key primitive generation, we preliminary success the shot classification, object recognition and tracking.

articleTitle: A Novel Digital Spiked Shoes Design and Testing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper designs a novel digital force measurement spiked shoes. Acquire three dimensional forces of the spikes, then stored it in SD card in the vamp. As for the athletes provides assistance with acquiring the three dimensional force between the spiked shoes and the runway. Digital spiked shoes mainly include the three-dimensional force sensor, data collector, SD memory card and PC display software. In the simulated test on the force platform, comparison with force platform and digital spiked shoes test results that show good consistency.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Scoring System of Test of the Actual Competition Ability of Basketball Under Separate Enrollment System in Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The national Separate Enrollment in physical education is an independent examination set by the state general sport administration including tests of Extracurricular courses and tests of specialty. Test of Basketball, one of the special tests, consists of 60-metre running, approach run and touch basket board, and shooting in limited time, dribble and shoot from diverse directions, and actual competition ability. This system realizes referees scoring and electronic display scene shows in the five to five basketball test. ASP.NET language and SQL Server database are adopted to complete such functions as roll-calling and grouping, ratings and scoring, printing, and successfully applied in test of specialty.

Author Keywords: the national Separate Enrollment in PE

articleTitle: The Practice and Exploration of Human Factors Engineering Course Design about the Sports Equipment Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The human factors engineering experiments is the sports equipment engineering students practical ability of the important ways. According to sports equipment engineering students in the actual situation of the basic requirements for personnel training course on human factors engineering course design was to explore, to experiment into the human factors engineering course design, and curriculum design pattern specification.

articleTitle: Application of SEBT on Core Training Measurement on Fin Swimming Athletes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of core training on dynamic stability competency on elite fin swimming athletes by SEBT. The subjects in this study were 24 elite fin swimming athletes from Chinese national team, are randomly divided into two groups: core training group and traditional training group. The training planning was 50 minutes/session, 4 times/week for 8weeks. S-E-T is taken as main mean, and also Swiss ball supplemented with other core training methods were given to core training group, while traditional training group is given conventional lower back and abdomen strength training, such as V up and so on. We measured the changes of dynamic stability competency of the participants by SEBT both pre and post the whole training. The dynamic stability competency increased drastically followed the 8-weeks core training, and the difference between pre and post training was very significant (p<; 0.01). Moreover, core training group was superior to traditional training group and had extremely significant difference after 8-weeks training (p<;0.01). Eight weeks core training can significantly improve the dynamic stability of fin swimmers compared with conventional lower back and abdomen strength training. SEBT can show neuromuscular control (proprioception), lower body strength, and ROM thoroughly and accurately.

articleTitle: Knowledge Rule Discovery Based on Training Data of Rowing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to better guide training according to the training test data, this paper uses the method of the time series data analysis, to obtain the knowledge rules from the training data of rowing through analysis. Namely the basis of different training content and the test project, we establish the different threshold value, thus obtain the athlete training effect of different time: The training excessively slightly, training quantity oversized, the training result enhancing with steady steps. The knowledge rules may be provided to the trainer to formulate the training plan for reference, thus we can enhance the science training effect.

articleTitle: Kinematics Simulation of Sit to Stand Based on SimMechanics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Sit to stand is one of the essential physical tasks of normal daily function, it requires coordinated constructions of the muscle of the lower extremities and truck. Specifically, subjects with movement disorder have reported to experience difficulties in rising from a seated position. Based on the captured signals, the angle and angular velocity of the STS, this paper simulate the STS on SimMechanics and get a similar result with the force plate.

articleTitle: Challenges and Countermeasures for Thermal Environment and Indoor Air Quality in Sports Buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The sports building is often crowded with many sports practitioners, so the thermal environment and indoor air quality in the sports buildings are very important to the athletes and other sports practitioners. Many problems such as different demands between auditorium and playing area, air conditioning system design and air conditioning operation exist in sports buildings in order to improve the thermal environment and indoor air quality. In view of the problems, it's proposed to compare the air distributions of different working conditions for optimal flow pattern, consider the usual requirement and competition requirement in calculating the air conditioning load and explore the testing and evaluation technology of thermal environment and indoor air quality. The general suggestions will provide references to the guarantee of the thermal environment, indoor air quality and energy efficiency in sports buildings.

articleTitle: The Compensation Index of Unbalanced Structure of Athlete's Performance Ability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In the treatise of the Compensation Theory of Unbalance Structure of Athlete's Performance Ability, the "some range" show restricts conditions in the usage. By founding two types of "cask model" on border condition, considering what structure is the unbalanced structure and how compensation is the unbalanced structure compensation is the two sides of the "some range". The new concept of compensation index can take the affection on quantify unbalanced structure and compensation. The establishment of individual model in favor of carries out respectively training. Compensation index can get up the affection of judge the athletic ability type, illuminate the complementary relationships and weather the athletic ability development lie in unbalance state.

articleTitle: Development and Application of the Web based Multimedia Teaching System of Football Rules
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The paper studies on development and application of the Web-based multi-media teaching system of football rules by methods of courseware development, investigation and teaching experiments. Teaching experiment showed the experience group was better than the contrast group in test of cognition. The questionnaire showed the feasibility of applying the teaching system.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Image Correlation Matching Based on Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: An improved evolutionary algorithm is proposed, and then it is used to solve image correlation matching. It has some new features: 1) using multi-parent search strategy and stochastic ranking strategy, which can enhance the search ability and exploit the optimum offspring, 2) two mutation strategies are proposed: low probability mutation strategy for the early mutation, and high probability strategy for the late mutation to enhance the diversity of population, the experimental results demonstrate that the performance in this paper outperforms that of other evolutionary algorithms in terms of the quality of the final solution, its stability is better and its computational cost is lower than the cost required by the other techniques compared.

articleTitle: Reflection and Exploration of Interactive Teaching in College English Intensive Reading Classroom of Newly Built Universities under Network Environment in Minority Areas
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: College English Intensive Reading is a course of comprehensive skills. Its main purpose is to develop and improve students' comprehensive abilities of using English, but more or less there still exist problems to be solved in classroom interactive teaching during the practical teaching process in newly-built undergraduate universities in minority areas. However, if we redefine and reconstruct the roles of teachers and students in the interactive reading class based on multi-media network environment and introduce the interactive teaching mode, students' learning initiative will be greatly improved and the teaching effect of College English Intensive Reading will be significantly enhanced.

articleTitle: An Improved RLS Adaptive Filter Algorithm Used to Process Human Body Balance Signal
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The human body balance measurement and analysis system ask for high precision to the center of gravity. This article in view of noise filter problem, analyze the insufficiency of commonly used data smoothing method and the classics RLS algorithm, proposed one kind of improved RLS adaptive filtering algorithm, the practical application effect is extremely ideal.

articleTitle: The Research and Development of the Combination Revolving Basketball Shooting Trainer
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper is a comprehensive upgrading research and applied study based upon the new national practical patent. It employs a literature research with theoretical method of basketball shooting and action learning as well as control theory and outcomes at home and abroad in recent years, on the basis of integrated methods, such as literature, experiments and logical method. This research designs the Combination Revolving Basketball Shooting Trainer (CRBST) and has the theoretical analysis on its design theory, technique principles, key feature indicators and applied patterns, in accordance with research results from modern physiology and psychology. In addition, an attempt is made with breakthrough in aspects of forms and methods of basketball shooting training, thus providing with the new efficient shooting equipments.

articleTitle: Study of the Present Situation and Future Development of Sports Equipment and Instruments in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: For making the comprehensive understanding and the inquire deeply to our country sports instrument equipment's research present situation and the trend of development, used literature search, investigation methods and so on, has carried on the review to our country sports instrument equipment's developing process, elaborated the sports instrument equipment's concept, the classification and the research present situation comprehensively. The result indicated that the sports instrument equipment takes the modern sports scientific research the important content, in the past several decades, its research has achieved the amazing achievement, promoted our country sports science and technological development, but, compares with the developed country also has certain disparity. At the same time, the author has carried on the forecast to the 21st century our country sports instrument equipment's trend of development.

articleTitle: Research on the Methods of the Trimming Sails During the Leg of the Windward Based on the Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In the sailing race of Olympic Games, it takes the longest time in the leg of the Windward and the rank of first reaching the mark1 is quite important, which mostly determines whether the team wins or fails in this round. Good skill of the trimming sail during the leg of the windward is based on the deep knowledge of aerodynamic property of the sail. The article studies the aerodynamic property of the sail of Olympic Games with the Numerical Simulation method. The study shows that in the leg of the Windward the main method of competitors attacking and defending each other is to trimming the sail based on the impact of factors on the aerodynamic of sail, which are mast, the angle of attack, angle of the pitch of the sail, camber of the sail and so on. Therefore, if the sailboat would be the same tack or not the overlap, it's a good method of obtaining an advantageous position to frequently trimming sails to influence the motion of other sailing boats by using the interactional sail shadow and air turbulent flow. This paper has contributed to the breakthrough of zero medal in Olympic sailing competition based on the numerical simulation method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Body Composition Comparison between the Han and Uygur PE Majors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By using SPSS 17.0, compared the Physical Health T-test results of 102 Han national students from Department of Physical Education, Southwest University with the results of 102 Uygur Students who are individually from Institute of Physical Education of xinjiang Normal University and Hotan Teachers College, the analysis shows: 1, there are notable differences of the height, MM (Muscle Mass) and bone volume between the female Han and Uygur students, there are also differences of the weight and FM (Fat Mass) between the males, 2, the comparison of girth measurement shows, there are circumference differences of the chest, inner and outer thigh between the females, and differences of the hip, chest, abdomen, outer thigh, and upper arm between the males, 3, there are differences of extra cellular fluid, hydration level and edema swelling index between the females, and differences of edema swelling index between the males, 4, the comparison of body fat percentage and total protein shows, there are differences of BMI (Body Mass Index) between the females, and differences of fat percentage, waist-and-hip ratio and BMI between the males. In this thesis, the reasons of these differences are analyzed, by which some theoretical references for different national physical education are provided.

articleTitle: The Study on Fitness Clubs Development in Large and Medium-Size Cities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In the 21st century, the tertiary industry has become a leading industry for economic development. Sports industry in the tertiary industry is the sunshine industry. And fitness as the most important component of sports industry, which should be taken seriously. Currently fitness market of large and medium-size cities have not yet fully developed, the market has great potential. Therefore, this paper uses literature to study and provide countermeasures and suggestion on fitness clubs in the large and medium size cities, which refers to promote fitness develop rapidly.

articleTitle: Special Performance Forecast for Shot Put Based on GA-BP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By using the characteristics of global optimization of GA and local optimization of BP neural network, the calculation accuracy and convergence rate of the traditional BP neural network are improved. Then a special performance forecasting model for shot put based on GA-BP is established. The numerical results show that the mean square errors, the mean absolute value of calculation and prediction are diminished. Therefore GA-BP is suitable to solve nonlinear problems such as prediction of special performance, and has high accurateness and application value.

articleTitle: The Self-organization Mechanism about Sports Industrial Structure Evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Based on Dissipative Structure Theory of the sports industrial self-organization mechanism of evolution, that openness - the evolution of sports structure prerequisite for self-organization, far from equilibrium - the evolution of sports structure of direct incentives for self-organization, non-linear role - sports evolution of the internal industrial structure based on self-organization, fluctuation - dissipation structure is sports structure triggers, leading industry - self-organization evolution of sports structure order parameter. Optimization of industrial structure should be raised around the sport of Recreation and Sport Event start two parallel chain. From: first, to have a certain social capital and investment rates, market demand should be relatively abundant, there must be appropriate and innovative strategies for supporting institutional reforms to consolidate the four basic sports operation of the leading industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Hydrodynamic of the SKUD 18 Class Hull
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The paper is using the MAXSURF software to model a SKUD 18 Class boat hull, and using the SPAN to research the hull performance of the SKUD 18 Class. We can get the data about the hull hydrodynamic of the SKUD 18 Class in different wind speed. By calculating, it help us to initial control the ship at different wind angles of the sail surface propulsion, sail plane lateral force, hull resistance, sail heeling moment of plane, ship and other indicators of change in torque characteristics.

articleTitle: Lossless Compression On-Board Remote Sensing Satellites
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Image processing on-board satellites is no longer a nice to have feature. Lossless image compression allows increasing the stored data on-board satellite and transmitting it to the ground station without losing quality of the images. An overview of development trend in this area, as well as brief state-of-the-art lossless image compression methods on-board satellites are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Large-scale Sporting Events: A Catalyst to Promote City Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the deepening of the socialization of sports, sporting events, especially large-scale sporting events present a tendency of diversity, and are impacting increasingly widely on the city. The paper discusses the active roles large-scale sporting events play in promoting city competitiveness, mainly in the following aspects: to improve urban infrastructure standards, and optimize urban living environment, to stimulate urban economic development, and create urban characteristic industries, to provide high-quality public service, and show the integrated management level of cities, to attract public participation, and enhance the overall strength of urban sports, to shape the characteristic brand image of cities by hosting the sporting events, to improve social soft environment of cities, and enhance cities' soft power.

articleTitle: Preparation of Test Measuring Table on University Students' Learning Burnout about Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: According to interviews, examination results of semi-open questionnaires and theoretical hypotheses, this paper proposes the method for preparation of measuring table on university students' Learning burnout about physical education. Results show that based on exploratory factors analysis the measuring table is confirmed to include emotional turndown, behavioral unsuitableness and low personal accomplishment, explaining 55.895% of the total amount of variation. Coefficient a in the general measuring table is 0.901, and that in the sub-measuring table is between 0.786 and 0.874, and the retest reliability is 0.855. The related coefficient between each sub-measuring table and the general measuring table is between 0.735 and 0.883, relation being prominent at level 0.001, and the content validity of the measuring table being good. The related coefficient between every two sub-dimensions is between 0.445and 0.655, indicating that the measuring table has certain structure validity. This measuring table is of high reliability and validity, and can be used in the test of university students' Learning burnout about physical education.

articleTitle: Study on Management Risk Evaluation of Sports Event under Fuzzy Comprehensive Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This article based on the relevant literature theories about risk of sports events domestic and international, by using the methods like document-research, Delphi, AHP etc, to construct the evaluation system and its weight of management risk of sporting events, through the use of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation building the Management risk assessment models, and evaluate the Track and Field Risk in 11th National Games under the fuzzy comprehensive, thinks its management risk is general in accordance with the principle of maximum degree.

articleTitle: The Index Selection of Body Composition Modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Statistics of body composition was measured by In body 3.0, use mathematical statistics method to select the related index of influencing body composition in the college P.E. major students, The result shows that the main index of influencing body composition in the college P.E. major students are control of fat, body density, muscle, extra cellular fluid, TP total protein, bone total protein, lean body weight, moisture total protein, Body moisture content, fat, Fat percentage and BMI etc.12 index in all. The aims of this paper are, firstly to improve the current situation of select the body composition index aimlessly, secondly to provide technical consult for insure the evaluation index of body composition.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Index System about Integration Sports Public Service between Urban and Rural
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper studies the connotations of Urban and Rural Integration of Sports public service and establishes the index system for the service evaluation by using the methods like Document-research, Delphi, AHP etc. And this index system contains three first-level indices and seventeenth second-level indices, each has been ascertained the index weight. And finally it was applied to the comprehensive evaluation of eight municipals and counties in Jiangsu province, China. What we got is that there are 3 district of southern Jiangsu are in the diffusion stage of the Urban and Rural Integration of Sports public service while there are 3 districts located in the central region of Jiangsu are in the starting phase, 3 districts in northern Jiangsu just in the preparation stage.

articleTitle: The Research on Information Interaction of the Mass Sports Overall Development in Urban and Rural
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Information interaction has been the important position of the mass sports overall development in the urban and rural, the article has a sample empirical investigation of the mass sports overall development in the urban and rural, and discuss the information Interaction differences between urban and rural, Based on it the article Analysis the strategic countermeasures of mass sports information Interaction development in the urban and rural.

Author Keywords: Overall Development in Urban and Rural

articleTitle: Study on Cervical Spine Stresses Based on Finite Element Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Objective: To establish three dimensional finite element model of the whole cervical spine and investigate biomechanical characteristic of the human cervical spine for application of clinical diagnosis and therapy. Method: A healthy adult female was subjected, three dimensional finite element model of the whole cervical spine was established using the method of 3D interpolation with CT. Result: The model included seven vertebrae, five discs, postical structure and seven ligaments. The volume of the whole model is 74 878.34mm3, the surface area is 32 616.04mm2, which consisting of 578 007elements, 123 358nodes, comparing the simulation data with the literature, the validity of the model was verified. Conclusion: The three-dimensional finite element model simulates the structure and property of cervical spine, whose structure is whole, its elements is fine, the model is very accurate and credible. The equivalent (Von Mises) stress of centum, facet joints and intervertebral disc in flexion is higher than in extension, the result of the biomechanical study was better correlated with the available experimental data. This indicates that the model can be used to analyze the biomechanics characteristic of the human cervical spine f in different condition.

articleTitle: Men Athletics Results of Value Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Using the method of statistical analysis of China's scientific man in Olympic athletics the status and value, according to the 11th national twenty nine games, select the man athletics events and Olympic Games in the top 30 before three grades, the percentage of statistical standard grades, and sorting items, the analysis results showed 20km race, 50km, 110m column, marathon, boasting, long jump, triple jump, javelin national projects, the highest gold 400m, 400m, 800m, 1500m, shot put, hammer projects of the national medal of low value. Studies suggest that use of scientific research and systematic analysis method, Chinese man athletics technical level, analyzes on the track and field sports scores man the status and value for our country to realize the plan, provide some scientific theory of target.

articleTitle: Systematic Analysis on Laboratory Management Informationization of Physical Education Department
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: 21 century is the information and Internet Age. With the rapid development of information and network technology, this century's laboratory management becomes able to employ brand-new technologies and convenient and effective managerial methods. New contents have been added to standardize and modernize the scientific management. At the same time, new challenges and chances keep cropping up. PE Department laboratory in colleges and universities severs as a multifunctional base for activities like teaching, training, scientific research and application and so on so forth. However, a few problems have arisen during the process of managing a lab, such as, low opening level and utilization rate, need-to-be-improved lab staff construction, slow query speed on experimental programs and the availability of lab equipments, poor technical service and equipment maintenance and backwardness of distance education and other computer-aided education forms.

articleTitle: Three-layer Fast Image Matching Algorithm Research Based on Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: A three-layer fast image matching algorithm based on Evolutionary Algorithm is proposed. It has some new features: 1A strategy from coarse matching to fine matching is adopted. Large numbers of non-matching points will be firstly eliminated by performing coarse matching with circular and cross templates, then a whole template is applied to confirming the final position to reduce the calculation workload; 2) two mutation strategies are proposed: low probability mutation strategy for the early mutation; and high probability strategy for the late mutation to enhance the diversity of population. The experimental results demonstrate that the performance in this paper outperforms that of other evolutionary algorithms in terms of the quality of the final solution, its stability is better and its computational cost is lower than the cost required by the correlation method and the circular method.

articleTitle: The Affection of Posture of Tai Chi Exercise to Internal Force and Muscular Torque of Knee and Ankle
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The purpose of the research is to test and calculate the athletes' internal strength and muscular torque of knee and ankle at different postures during Tai Chi Exercise through researching fourteen excellent Chinese Wushu athletes, taking embracing knee and bending step as typical actions and applying reverse dynamics as basic theory. The result shows that in some extent the change of the postures may cause the change of load intensity, but may not be the main factor of joint injury and pain. The quantity of load may be regarded as the main factor. Controlling time and frequency should be the most important factor for avoiding joint injury and pain.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Simulation of Sustainable Development Model of Chinese Athletic Talent Reserve
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the research method of system dynamics tools, the paper analyses the internal and external factors influencing the sustainable development of the Chinese athletic talent reserve, design the system dynamics equation by using the ratio of athlete population as the core variable and drawing the chart of cause and effect and construct the system dynamics model. The paper also uses the Vensim PLE to simulate the athletic talent reserve development trend from 2006 to 2020. The simulation results show that the development model of the complete integration education is the most efficient, professional development model comes next, then the model of traditional three-level training and the social development model is the least efficient. Thus, various kinds of athletic talent reserve development models should be adopted for its sustainable development in the future.

articleTitle: Thoughts on Application of Multimedia in Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Introduction of information technology in teaching and learning becomes more and more popular and is one of the major concerns of education reforms nowadays. This paper focuses on the application of multimedia in education, analyzes the definition of multimedia and the benefits it brings in learning and instruction, examines the paradigm shift in teaching and learning owing to application of multimedia, addresses the multimedia tools and online technologies, then examines the specific designing using multimedia. At last authors note that multimedia by itself does not assure a good learning environment, it should be designed and monitored properly.

articleTitle: An Analysis and Study of Technical Characteristics of the Chinese Elite Open Female Rowers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: 4 Chinese elite Open-women rowers are chosen, make use of the "Rower Expert Light" (WEBA Sport) to collect the data of 1×rowing technique and analysis. With the increase in tempo, drive and recovery become more rapidly, but push propeller speed increase faster, there is no significant increase in the strength of drive, and the strength of drive for boat speed does not play a decisive role. under the same tempo, less single paddle time, the less ratio of Push and pull will help get faster boat speed. The imbalance of right-left pulling force and the different position of the most strength of drive is appearing will affect the course and speed. In 3 tempo, to 4 athlete, their angle of entry always greater than their angle of release. With the increase in tempo, the angle of hands away no significant change, but bigger the angle of hands away will help increase boat speed. With the increase of tempo, positive acceleration and negative acceleration are increasing too, but range of negative acceleration and the proportion of range of negative acceleration among stroke cycle time decrease which obviously in favour of increase boat speed.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Model in Sports Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Cloud model delivers uncertainty conversion between qualitative and quantitative. Easy to reveal the uncertainty of universal law in sports field. Using cloud for analysis of students' physical condition, it is intuitive and flexible, easy to reveal small area data, features and so on.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Bridge's Dynamic Response under Vehicular Load
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In this paper, the effects of random road surface roughness and vehicular speed, lane position on the impact effect due to moving vehicles are investigated. For simplicity, the bridge and moving vehicles are simulated as two separate elastic structures. Two sets of equations of motion can be written with the adoption of virtual work principle and finite element method. The displacement equation and the vehicle-bridge interaction equation that make the two sets of equations coupled are proposed. According to GB/T7031-1986, the sample values of random road surface roughness are obtained. The dynamic equations for vehicle are solved in Matlab with Wilson's θ method, and then the bridge's dynamic equations are worked out by ANSYS, thus bridge's dynamic response under vehicular load are acquired. The numerical results show that the value of impact factor increases with vehicle's speed, decreases with the vehicle's distance from the bridge axis, and increases significantly with the deterioration of highway bridge deck roughness.

articleTitle: The Sports Tourism Impacts - The Case Study of Olympics Event
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In recent decades, tourism industry has rapidly developed, and that also brings various impacts to the destinations and nations, particularly in economic impact. Therefore more and more experts would like to contribute to this field, and research different types of tourism. This study will concentrate on sports tourism, Olympic Games and the various benefits and impacts experienced by host cities and host countries. Further to discuss if the Olympics create good opportunities to improvement of national and international image and what impacts will be generated by the event. In general, the impacts divide two categories which are positive and negative. Based on this research, it will get abundant reasonable and valuable methods, effective experiences. Then, to minimize the negative impact, encourage the positive one.

Author Keywords: positive and negative impacts of sports tourism

articleTitle: On the Construction and Utilization of the Information-based Integrated Managing System for Monitoring and Disciplining Student Physical Constitution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The information-based managing system for monitoring and disciplining student physical constitution is a general internet-based managing platform which applies the advanced testing equipments and computer technology, the theory of constitution testing and evaluation to monitor and discipline student constitution. The system covers the dynamic managing of student healthy, the testing and monitoring of student constitution, the disciplining and prescription system, and the education of life facts. It also probably provides students with the instruction of self-exercising, and throws light on the teaching and research of Physical Education.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Changes of Body Shape and Quality about Backup Talents of Women's Volleyball
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: According to testing data of body shape and tactics quality indicators from nationwide volleyball high level backup talents training camp" in 2004 to 2007 ", the paper made related research on the dynamic changes of body shape and quality about volleyball backup talents by applying scientific research methods, this is to fully understand and grasp situation and dynamic characteristics of the existing body shape and tactics backup talents, we are to provides important theoretical basis for research and analysis growth characteristics and excellent volleyball players about the high level backup talents team.

articleTitle: Research of Cycling Phase Identification Based on Multi-channels sEMG
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Objective: The objective of this study is to identify the cycling phase by using surface electromyography(sEMG). Methods: Eight professional cyclists participated in this study. Each subject performed a 30-second all-out cycling exercise. The braking torque imposed on cycling motion was 8% of each subject's weight. sEMG of Rectus Femoris(RF), Biceps Femoris(BF), Tibialis Anterior(TA) and Gastrocnemius Lateralis(GL) were recorded during the process. Wavelet packet transformation was performed to compute the energy for the frequency range 10-50Hz. On this basis, energies were selected as feature vectors and can be the inputs and cycling phase can be the output of Elman network. After trial-and-error optimization procedure, optimal ANN Model was developed. Results: The factor of cycling phase had a significant effect on the energy for the frequency range 10-50Hz. The prediction accuracy reached to 78.1%, implying a high-precision of the model output. Conclusions: The metergasis of RF, BF, TA, GL can be well reflected by the energy for the frequency range 10-50Hz. The predicted result of ANN was very similar with the measured value, indicating that the combination of 10-50Hz frequency band energy and Artificial Neural Network is feasible in identifying cycling phase using multi-channels sEMG. The main reason of the predicted error can be explained by the time delay between video and sEMG, and the low pass filtering effect of muscles tissue's changing during cycling exercise.

articleTitle: Research on the Hedge Ration of IF1006 Contract
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In China, the stock index futures were launched on April 16, 2010 during a period of mock trading. This paper is research on the hedging of CSI 300 index by using the IF1006 contract, Established OLS, VAR, GARCH, VEC and other mathematical models for analysis the hedge ratio of stock, and using minimum variance criteria to evaluation. The results show that selecting the appropriate mathematical model for hedging can make perfect effect.

articleTitle: The Review of Influence Factors of Our Country School Sports Facilities Safety and Intervention Measures
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The safety of school sports playgrounds and facilities have influence on the school sports work. Based on our school sports facilities construction development, incorrect construction and maintenance out of time, this text discuss Influence factors of our country school sports facilities safety and intervention measures, such as the government should further increase funding. Schools should solve facilities deficiency, multi-channel school sports facilities, schools should open sports playgrounds and facilities of the management and maintenance system shall be set up.

articleTitle: A Study on the Development Strategy of Ice and Snow Sports Tour
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: the present study mainly did an analysis on the development strategy of ice and snow sports tour. Based on the characteristics of the resources in Xinjiang, the present argues that the state of being "three classifications and four regions have been built with the characteristics of being close to the suburban area, changeable time, the imbalanced distribution of guests sources. Meanwhile, the present study has analyzed some main factors that may influence the development of Xinjiang ice and snow sports tour and finally points out the strategy of Urumqi Ice and snow tour development. Up to now, the statistics shows that there are altogether 570.000 tourists in the 22 skiing resort in Urumqi, with almost 30,000,000 RMB per year. Recently, silk road ice and snow festival has been held in Xinjiang for altogether 5 times, which bring Xinjiang's ice and snow tour to the whole country. With the promotion of the silk road ice and snow festival, some promotion activities in large scales have been held in Urumqi. Until now, the conditions of the skiing resorts have been improved a lot. The city of Urumqi has rich ice and snow tour resources in winter, which have strong local ethnic features. In addition, Urumqi is surrounded by mountains in three parts, which may provide good natural skiing resort for the development of winter tourism. According to the analysis to some main scenic spots, at present, there has been a winter skiing tourist market of around 1,000,000 people per year, with a increasing rate of 20%. Obviously, winter ice and snow tourism has been a new economic increasing point of Urumqi tourism economy, which will attract more tourists in China and abroad.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Basic Connotation of PIN-bonding Sport Training Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Firstly this paper outlined the PIN-bonding sport training theory, then from three dimensions the paper elaborated its basic connotation via literature-material method, logical analytic method and so on. These three dimensions are discriminative dimension of P(physical ability), I(intelligence), N(non-intelligence), sport training influencing dimension and their relation dimension. Eleven groups, twenty-five propositions were involved in this study.

articleTitle: The Management and Maintenance of Computer Room in Physical Department of Common University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The computer rooms in physical department of common university undertake various of professional experiments and curriculum design teaching. How to reasonably use limited resources to better serve for the teaching, research and practical ability of students is particularly important. According to the status and the problems of computer room, the meaning and necessity of students' participation in the management of computer room was analysis, and on the basis, some Specific measures focusing on the students' participating in the management of computer room were described.

articleTitle: Research on Failure of China Team in the 23rd Uber Cup Badminton Finals
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By mainly using the methods of video observation and statistics to analyze the final four games between China and Korea in the 23rd uber cup badminton. Results: In The first women's singles, the Chinese team is better than South Korea in the net scoring, pumping block scores, hanging split score and lofty goals scores, but is inferior to their opponent in smash score and initiative scores, too much mistakes is a main cause for the failure of Chinese team, in the second women's singles, the Chinese team showed advantage over their opponent in net scores, hanging split scores, initiative scores and smash scores among which difference smash scores reached a significant level, but scores lost for opponents' mistake still take up the largest percentage of the total score, in the first women's doubles, Chinese team is better than South Korea getting initiative scores but is less than South Korea in net scores with roughly equal scores in other aspects. Too many mistakes is a direct cause for the lost of Chinese team, in the second women's doubles, the Chinese team showed a significant advantage over South Korea in net scores, but the score difference in initiative scores between South Korea has reached significant level. To provide a reference for China women's badminton team when sum up experience and lessons in finals.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Physical Exercise, Physical Health and Physical Self-confidence of University Students
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper adopts "PARS-3 Physical Activity Grade Measuring Table", and "Physical Self-Confidence Measuring Table" to test the physical exercise situation and physical self-confidence of 327 university students. Results show that: physical exercise has positive influence on physical health and physical self-confidence, in the influence of physical exercise on physical self-confidence, the influence of exercise frequency is relatively big, in the influence of physical health on physical self-confidence, the influence of endurance items and standing long jump is relatively big, in the influence of physical exercise on physical health, the influence of exercise frequency and time of exercise is relatively big.

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Application of Rugby Scrum Equipment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The paper aims to solve problems existing in rugby scrum technology, such as quantizing strength, preventing neck injury, adjusting technical motions according to standard etc. Develop scrum educational and training equipment to replace human power by mechanical engineering designs, mechanic experiments, design calculation and manufacture. The test gives us the crucial technical data and inspects the model machine in the actual application. We can conclude that there is a relation between the weights and ejection force. If the confidence interval is in this range, P<;0.05, and under the condition of 1-α=95%, then the load-carrying capability range is credible. It verified that the reliable performance of the rugby scrum ejection force function and it has a good effect on improving rugby scrum teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index System of Crisis Management about Sports Field
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Crisis management is an important component of managements about sports field, and the quality of crisis management about sports field requires giving a scientific index system to evaluate. Through searching relevant literatures, this paper analyzes the crisis of sports field, crisis management of sports field, and the process about crisis management of sports field, On the basis of above, it sets up the evaluation index system of crisis management about sports field, and through using expert advice, mathematical statistics, AHP, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and other methods, it determines the weights about corresponding evaluation index system.

articleTitle: Technology Characteristics of Trampoline Athletes' Plantar Pressure in Doing Basic Movement on Bed
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In this essay 11 Shanghai's professional trampoline athletes' pre jump and 5 basic skill movements were analyzed by video and plantar pressure method. Plantar pressure data was acquired. According to trampoline program characteristics, data was analyzed in statistics method and rules of trampoline during the process of touching net were explored. Research result showed that there were no significant difference between different movements in each foot sole region pressure, intensity of pressure in 8 key points and distance of center of pressure in X-axis and Y-axis, which demonstrated that touching net skill of different type movements were the same. During touching net process, peak value of intensity pressure of the 5th toe phalanges and the heel were the maximum. The distance of center pressure in X-axis during the touching net process was stable while during the push-off phase the distance was remarkable for the reason that two legs exerted imbalance strength.

articleTitle: Study on Impact of Social Development of College Students by Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By means of experiment, the study, which is based on a questionnaire named 'a questionnaire for teenagers' ability to adjust to society', focuses on undergraduates' ability to adjust to society. The experiment related to 272 undergraduates and lasted 16 weeks. The aim is to find whether the college students' ability to adjust to society will change when they choose different PE course. The results are as follows. Martial arts, tea kwon do, aerobics dancing and the sports of basketball courses could improve the colleges' social adaptability. However, the martial arts and tea kwon do courses did better than others.

articleTitle: The Chinese Alphabetic Passwords in the Fingers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Now Robots have only the computer technology and can only achieve vague control and analog control due to the lack of design concept on the Robot rational conduct procedures-the Intelligent Science, this restricts the development of Robot. The Intelligent Science + the Computer Technology = the Intelligent Robots. Only when people have deciphered the mystery of human mind-the Intelligent Science, accurate control of Robot will be realized, and the Robots will evolve into the high stage-the Intelligent Robot. In accordance with the Nature-Man Unity idea, the Intelligent Science begins with the study of Alphabetic Passwords in the fingers.

articleTitle: Research on Principal Components Weighted Based on Real-valued Negative Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to improve the identification and distribution performance of the detector, this paper proposes Principal Component Weighted Real-valued Negative Selection Algorithm(PCW-RNS) which is based on principal component weighting. The similarity between this algorithm and the classical real-valued detector generating algorithm based on generation-and-elimination lies in the fact that neither adopt any optimization method to optimize the performance of the detector, but only relying on the detection performance of the detector to detect anomalies. Because of the irrelevance between the principal components and the application of weighted Euclidean distance as the matching rules, the detector can adjust its radius according to the distribution of non-self space, thus obtaining higher detection rate of the detector and improving distribution performance of the detector. In this way, we can not only better the identification performance of the detector and obtain a higher detection rate, but also effectively reduce the false alarm rate.
