articleTitle: The Application of Information Technology in Building Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Information technology is changing every aspect of people's life with enormous incalculable impact. The purpose of this paper is to research how we can apply information technology to building energy saving. It analyzes the application of information technology in the design, construction and operation phrase in life cycle of the construction and proposes to strengthen the use of information technology in building energy saving work. It is proved that the proper use of information technology can achieve great energy saving. The new of this paper lies in integrating information technology with the main phases of construction.

articleTitle: The Application of Diversified Multimedia Techniques in Swimming Courseware
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The introduction of using 3D multimedia simulation techniques and multimedia techniques such as Author ware designing to swimming courseware, and the development of the courseware of three-dimensional multimedia simulation techniques for the swimming education will give full play to the advantages of diversified multimedia techniques and thus serve quality-oriented education better under the teaching model of paying more attention to the interaction of teachers and students and the active participation of the students.

articleTitle: Regulation of Nano Silica on Mechanical Properties of Gymnastic Artificial Turf
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: A new type of LLDPE/nano silica (SiO2) composite based artificial turf fibers with excellent tensile property and abrasion resistance is introduced in this paper. The effect of SiO2 loading on properties shows that the tensile force and elongation at break reached the maximum value when the SiO2 content is 6%, and the abrasion loss of monofilament fibers get to the lowest point. Turf wear test indicates that after 12000 cycles test, the surface morphology of artificial turf weaved from monofilament fibers showed serious abrasion and branching phenomenon of neat LLDPE, while only slight abrasion and branching phenomenon occurred for the artificial turf filled with 6% nano SiO2. SEM images of cross sections of monofilament fibers show that nano SiO2 had a good dispersibility in monofilament fiber matrix.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Web Structure-Based News Gathering System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: On the basis of depth studying the technology of web information gathering, a web structure-based news gathering model is proposed. Firstly, it load the gathering entry address, find the news list page with the Information Gathering and Filter Algorithm, then identify and improve the news content page link address according to the rules set by acquisition and combined with regular expression technology automatically, and then load the target page-news content page, gather the news information with the algorithm automatically. At the same time, it can filter any information that is set in this page such as embedded advertising messages. Practical results show that the proposed model works well, it can gather news information efficiently and automatically.

articleTitle: Design of DSP Virtual Machine Oriented All-Digital Simulation and Testing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: To address this issue and guarantee the quality of embedded software, research on how to establish a pure software based target hardware runtime environment as to replace the real one was conducted. The core simdsp55x is an interpretive and execution driven virtual machine. According to the architecture of TI's TMS320C55x DSP, the mechanisms for virtual memory management, object file loading, instruction decoding and interrupts handling of simdsp55x had been described. To meet the practical application, a number of new features had been added.

articleTitle: Research Evaluation of Construction Studies Abroad on Job Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The research on construction of job performance started at the beginning of last century. Then the unidimensional construction model of job performance gradually developed into multidimensional one, which implies, the viewpoint that constituent part of job performance construction is consequences and outputs has been denied by researchers and simultaneously the study has focused on behavior characteristics, such as organizational citizenship behavior, task performance, contextual performance counterproductive behavior. Our research finally comes to the conclusion that the construction of job performance is a multidimensional one both in general industry and specific industry, which also includes the acquired results from some researchers and direction of special dimension as one of the influence factors on job performance for certain subjects.

articleTitle: Application Research of Aerobics Internet Course among University Student
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper aims to analysis the application effect of the internet courses of aerobics for the universities students through information retrieval, mathematical statistics, survey method and experimental method, and the writer designed and developed the internet courses of aerobics for the universities students.

articleTitle: Study of High-Performance Chloroprene Sponge in Diving Suit Application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: A diving-suit-used foam neoprene with high performance has been developed and its aging behaviors in QUV accelerated aging tank and temperature cyclic chamber were investigated. The results show that the tensile strength and tear strength of the material are decreased after 9d QUV accelerated aging due to the obvious cracks in the foaming cell. In temperature cycling the mechanical properties increased arising from cross linking reaction in the aging process. Besides, the chloride ion penetration resistance of the material was tested by dielectric flux intelligent tester, and the result shows that the material is of excellent chloride ion penetration resistance capability. The infiltration coefficient is 8.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/s.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Three-dimensional Digital Discus Based on MEMS Sensor
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Development a Three-dimensional digital based on MEMS sensor, which has the same mass and external dimensions with the normal discus. It can measure the information of acceleration and angular velocity in discus throw. Through calibrating experiments, the digital discus has good linearity and high accuracy, work reliability and better antijamming. This digital discus can be used to collect the signals sent out when throwing the discus on the whole process and carry through the dynamics analysis. It has been applied in the daily training. The mechanical design, force measuring principle and field experiment of the instrument are discussed in detail. Experiment results show that the information measuring method is correct and the instrument system is effective.

articleTitle: UML Visual Modeling Technology and Application
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Unified Modeling Language is a kind of language which can be applied to describing, visualizing, framing software system and to business modeling. It contains analysis, design and realization of object-oriented technology, providing abundant, precise expression with strong extension ability for object oriented system development, software automation tools and environment. The paper introduces the realization of object oriented analysis, design and iterative development within the whole software system by application of visualized modeling software tools based on UML, and by conveniently managing program requirements, use component-based architectures, verify software quality, controlling the version update according to demands.

articleTitle: The Recognition of Copyright Infringement under the Condition of P2P Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In the network technology, P2P software represented by BitTorrent in solving the problem of transmission of the large capacity files is a good solution, but it makes the copyright administration more difficult. This paper analyzes network transmission main body under P2P network technology conditions, its copyright infringement forms, and constituents of copyright infringement in detail. It is thought that P2P network technology is a kind of neuter technology, whether there is any infringement of copyright depends on the results of bjective facts and on the users' purposes, and the paper also puts forward some suggestions on how to protect copyright under P2P network transmission conditions.

articleTitle: Research of Portable and Atraumatic Instrumentation of Blood Oxygen Saturation Degree to the Movement of the Test of Physical Parameters
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The motion detection is a method of detecting sports players body condition. It is also an important tool to select athletes. The portable and a traumatic device of oxygen saturation in the blood test has provided the solution for continuous and dynamic test, and to avoid causing pain, as well. In medical field, a lot of studies of a traumatic oxygen saturation test have been researched and tested. On the other hand, the working principle, the operation, and the size of the device can not fulfill requirement of the motion detection. This essay proposed a system design of portable and a traumatic motion detection instrumentation of blood oxygen saturation degree based on the diffuse reflection principle.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of the Three-dimensional Information Collection System of Digital Discus to the Throwing Technique of the Discus Throwers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The authors developed a suit of the three-dimensional information collection system of digital discus, which has won the national invention patent. This system includes a digital discus, USB connecting line, position machine software and a personal computer. The digital discus is made up of the higher and lower shell, eyelets, circuit boards, accelerometer and angular rate sensor, etc. This system can be used to collect the real-time signals which are sent out during the whole throwing process and can carry out the dynamics analysis. By the synthetical use of both the system and the three-dimensional camera shooting, the research tests 3 excellent male athletes and obtains the result: the three-dimensional information collection system of digital discus is convenient, reliable and accurate. It provides a new way for the technical diagnosis and scientific research of the discus throw program.

articleTitle: An Application Study on the Simulation Horse in Control Ability Evaluation of Jockeys Riding
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: It is interesting that the higher rate of public concern and lack scientific research on riding techniques of speed horse race compare with equestrian. In this study, riding postures of different class jockeys were tested under varied speeds by means of simulation horse to explore a simple way of evaluating jockey's posture control ability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Video Magazine Player for Ping Pong Match
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Traditional video magazine only includes existing video or the video that producer re-created, but the video that users are interested can not be produced by them flexibly. Accordingly, this article puts forward a method for users to re-edit the video based on their ideas and the method contains the video annotation and video analysis techniques. Finally a new video magazine player which support for previewing and extracting the video is implemented. Currently, this player has been successfully used to re-edit the ping pong match video and coaches can quickly and accurately locate the motion that they concerned quickly and accurately. At the end, it illustrated the flexibility and practicality of the player after the test.

articleTitle: Mining of Association Model Pair in Multidimensional Structured Database
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In the paper we first propose a user preference model with the minimum support intelligent set method. Secondly, we propose a new data mining problem, the structure of the database to find frequent patterns associated pair. To effectively address these problems, we developed a series of cutting ability with a strong algorithm. The new algorithm is also discussed in the one-dimensional and multi-dimensional structure of the database found on the applicability of the model and to assess the efficiency of the new algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Components of Competency for the Instructor of Leisure Sports Club
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By methods of Literature, two-way behavioral event interview and statistics, the article studies the components of competence of leisure sports club instructors and points out 21 items of competence components. Meanwhile, the components are also ascertained from the viewpoints of students through the interview of excellent instructors' students. The results show that 14 items o f the total are also mentioned in the students interview, which includes honesty and integrity, communication skills, enthusiasm stimulation, etc. Therefore, it proves that the 14 items have direct influence on students and can be sensed by students. However, the other 7 items including relation establishment and customer capability are not shown in students' interview and they don't have direct influence on students and can not be sensed by the students.

articleTitle: Research on the Quantitative Evaluation of Cooperation between Boat and Oar in Canoe
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The canoe is an event that athletes use a paddle on one side of the boat to row, by harmonizing muscle groups in upper- and lower-limbs and trunk, so research on the cooperation among human, oars and boat is most important to improve athlete's technology and performance. In this paper, we measured 7 kinematic parameters, such as force and angles (pitching and upset) of oar, speed and angles (pitching and upset) of boat, frequency, during the process of which 6 national athletes rowed as fast as they could. We constructed kinematic model of each parameter, and on the base of these models we analyzed the cooperative relationship between human and oar, human and boat. The results showed that: (1) These models based on methods of normalizing and averaging could describe the technical characteristics of athletes, and variance and correlation analysis methods could analyze quantitatively the co-ordination between human and oar, human and boat which provided ways to real-time assess athlete's specialized skill.(2) Combined with the process of phasing paddle method, quantitative method evaluated the relationship between human and oar, human and boat which established the basis of understanding particular technique for coaches. At the same time, we found that the rowing skill of national athletes was most steady in the process of preparation phase and power stages, less steady in the process of grasp and orientation phase. (3) The pitching angle was most consistent during the period of rowing, otherwise the upset angle was most differential. The steady of boat was consistent with the upset angle.

articleTitle: Study on the Development of Sporting Goods Industries System Based on Self-organizing Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Through consulting materials and documents, the author gives a panorama for sporting goods industries system and gives an analysis for openness, limit of openness, state far from equilibrium, nonlinear, competition and cooperation, order parameter and fluctuation on sporting goods industries system in the means of mathematical statistics. According to the analysis, the author gives a summary: in our country, the sporting goods industries system is provided with institutional environment and conditions of evolution and development of self-organization, which are openness, state far from equilibrium and nonlinear. The competition and cooperation of the sporting goods industries system of all parts of the country came into being the regional brands, which is the order parameter of dominating the evolution and development of the system. Finally, the author puts forward the strategic thinking of the development of sporting goods industries system in our country under the guidance of self-organizing theory.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Sports Statistics Textbooks and Other Disciplines' Statistics Textbooks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Through the literature review, mathematical statistics and comparative studies have been done for the proportion of some sections in seven kinds of statistics textbooks. The seven kinds of statistics textbooks is respectively about sports, education, psychology, business, socio-economics, biology and medicine. The results show that sports statistics textbook should enforce the composition of research design, data collection and collation, and statistical reports, it is also suggested to pay more attention to the applicability of textbooks, the initiative of students and the introduction of statistical software. So this project aims at providing theoretical supports for statistics textbooks to be more conductive to the development of physical discipline of statistics and to be more suitable for students.

articleTitle: A Research of Emergency Classification Based Fuzzy AHP and Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The traditional emergency classification is lack of dynamic analysis in emergency rescue and disaster incident management, it is difficult to accurately quantify the classification and providing practical guidance and scientific issues. In this paper, Fuzzy AHP and cluster analysis of the classification is researched, it can effectively integrate expert consensus, it can meet emergency requirements and reflect the dynamic classification in the emergencies.

articleTitle: China's Consumption of Sports Entertainment Group of Social Stratification
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With China's rapid economic development, leisure time increased, the growth of per capita income, foreign exchange frequent, making more and more people on sports fitness and entertainment have a new understanding of the life of sports, daily trend will become increasingly evident. Through the study of social stratification theory surrounding the consumption of sports entertainment feature of the various consumer groups, found that middle-class elite in the consumer sector is the backbone of the sports entertainment, how to cultivate the future market has become the focus of this paper.

articleTitle: The Study on the Characteristics of Folk Sports Culture
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Folk sports as a special cultural characteristic, which not only has common characteristic of characteristic, but also has basic characteristic of their own culture. This study takes basic characteristic of folk sports culture as point of breakthrough, which studys continuity and expansion, stability and variability, hierarchy and objectivity, and standard and service four typical basic characteristics, and gets the conclusion as follows: (a) Continuity and expansion of folk sports prompt continuity to a type of time-space continuum. (b) Stable society prompts the stability of folk sports culture stronger. (c) stability and variability has become the internal motivation of folk sports culture's preservation and development. (d) The occurrence of folk sports stems from social productive labour. This study will deepen our appreciation on folk sports culture, and provide reference suggestion on preservation and development of folk sports.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Influencing Excellent Female 100-meter Race Score and Establishment of Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This paper has screened out major factor indices reflecting the excellent female 100-meter race score through investigation and expert interview, mathematical statistics. Predicated models were established for body training level and dedicated item score. Their relationship was also analyzed from multi-level, multi-perspectives through the combination of athletic measurement and evaluation, sport physiology, systematic theory, cybernetics and characteristics of items. The result shows that 1) The five major inspecting indices for 100-meter races for female athletes i.e. flying run 30m, stride length, stride frequency, ten-class standing long jump and 300m, have closely relation with the special item results. 2) Establishment of regression equation to forecast the results of China national master sportswomen, one class 100-meter races for female athletes. 3) Three kinds of evaluation methods and criteria for Chinese elite female 100-meter runners in this paper provide evidence for evaluating performance of physical training comprehensively. The three kinds of methods and evaluation criteria include comprehensive developing level, the equilibrium degree and adaptation degree of comprehensive developing level of physical training and special performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction about Evaluation Index System on New Rural Service System of Fitness for All
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Through analyzing the value of the construction about service system of Fitness for all in new countryside, we established the evaluation index system for it by using document-research method, Delphi method etc. This system contains six first-level indices, fifteen second-level indices and forty seven third-indices. We hope to provide scientific theory for the evaluation on service system of fitness for all in new countryside of China.

Author Keywords: service system of fitness for all

articleTitle: Rational Foundation of Chinese Sports Associations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Sports Associations are an important foundation of modern sports, why this is necessary from the sports community, why and how could the three perspective for a new Chinese sports associations of the presence of base (philosophical side, the economic side, the political side, sports area), human base and operating mechanism (formation mechanism, operating mechanism, control conditions), the rational basis of sports associations are analyzed in-depth study of the germinal Sports Associations operating mechanism to promote the healthy development of sports associations.

articleTitle: The Study on the Development Approaches of Traditional Sports Culture and Resources of Minority People in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: based on the discussion of the combined development of traditional sports cultural resources of minority people in Xinjiang and school sports, tourism, mass media, people's athletic meeting, public sports, the present study has done an analysis on the development approaches on sports culture and resources of minority people in Xinjiang and proposes some basic strategies of its development.

Author Keywords: traditional sports culture and minority people

articleTitle: International Development of the Research on the Hydrodynamic Performance of Rowing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The aim of the paper is to review the international development of the research on the hydrodynamic performance of rowing. The resistance of the shell can be split into three components, skin drag, form drag and wave resistance. The review analyzes the usual method of calculating the three drags in research on hydrodynamic performance of the shell and in optimization of the shape of the shell. The force acted on the oar blade, which provides the propulsion for forward motion of the shell, can be considered two components, lift and drag, or normal force and tangential force. There are two approaches to investigate the hydrodynamic performance of the shell and the blade, laboratory experiment and numerical simulation. It can be seen that there is perfect projects of the numerical simulation in the future, especial CFD commercial software.

articleTitle: The Simulation on the Resistance Plate of Rowing in Different Attacked Angles
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In this article, the numerical simulation had been done using the software Fluent. The resistances have been calculated in the different attacked angles. It can be seen from the simulation results that the variety of the velocity is much obvious than that of the attacked angles. The resistance is referred to the square of the velocity. When the angle attacked is increasing, the trends of the velocity increasing are more obvious. If the velocity is not large enough, the effects of the resistance training is not fine. The results about the computation on the resistance and life are correct, which can be applied in the training. Under the original skills, the training is much fine in the training. It can save time for training.

articleTitle: On Problems of Physical Education Laboratory Construction and its Development Strategies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By means of documentary and interview and methods of summarizing and induction, this paper analyzes major problems existing in Physical Education laboratory construction, namely low starting point, scanty funds, unreasonable structure of laboratory staff, low resource utilization and poor management, then strategies are put forward as suggestions to improve the adverse situation. Apart from necessary experimental equipments, materials, approaches and highly qualified personnel, a favorable environment and necessary facilities are also required. What's more, the key to lab construction lies in the recognition from leaders and support and collaboration from functional department. A lab contributes its adaptability of teaching and scientific research to emphasizing not only hardware reinforcement but the software construction like, the cultivation of teachers. Last but not least, it is effective to improve students' innovationess and hand-on skill by opening laboratory to students and merge ring those ones with overlapping functions into one interdepartmental and interdisciplinary PE lab centre.

articleTitle: Application and Advantage of Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation in Appraisal of PE Teachers in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: As a link of management of teachers and the core to reform of personnel system in colleges and universities, appraisal of teachers in colleges and universities also presents itself as the fundamental base to building a group with sound political, ideological and professional standards, optimized structure, stable backbone teachers and those who are highly trained and energetic. Therefore, perfection of appraisal of PE teachers is conducive to teachers and improving their standards while bearing vital importance in promoting teaching and levels of training. Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, which is therefore adopted with an intention to motivate PE teachers and realize the management conception based on people, aims to present a fuzzy description of morality, ability, attendance, result in appraisal and turns them into quantitative indexes, thus realizing the objective evaluation of performance, qualification and research quality of PE teachers, providing dependable scientific proof for employment, reward and punishment and training.

articleTitle: A Study about the Evaluation of Beauty of the Body Type of Female Students in College
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Aim: provide referential comprehensive model for evaluation of beauty of the body type of female students in college. Methods: basing on the test data of series of body shape indicators of female students in college aged 18 to 23 and the subjective ratings of their beauty of body type by teachers, use statistics analysis to select typical indicators and build the mathematical model of evaluation of beauty of the body type of female students in college. Our research methods include searching documentations, experimenting and statistics analyzing. Then do t test between the composite score calculated by the model and the subjective ratings by teachers. Result: The composite score calculated by the model and the subjective ratings by teachers have little difference, P>;0.05. Conclusion: the evaluating model of beauty of the body type of female students in college built by this research gives a scientific, rational and applicable evaluation for beauty of the body type of female students in college aged 18 to 23.

Author Keywords: Composite evaluation of beauty of body type

articleTitle: Paper According to China-ASEAN Background China's Guangxi Professional Training of the Vietnamese High-level Sports Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the methods of literature research, statistics method , tracking surveys and other methods, this paper analyzes the professional training status that Guangxi helps Veitnam in sports. Draw a conclusion: According to the background of China-Association of Southeast Asian Nations, Chinese sports market through its advanced and dominant culture and philosophy, has cultivated a group of "made in China" senior Vietnamese sports professionals. Meanwhile, as the establishment of China - Association of Southeast Asian Nations sports training base and three centers, Guangxi senior Vietnamese trained professionals in talent quantity and quality will be further improved. This is conducive to China's sports industry and the talent to enter and explore the Vietnamese market, promote China's Guangxi and Vietnam to train the sports professionals in order to form a "win-win cooperation" model.

articleTitle: Reject and Re-work Cost Control Based on Products Dimension Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Quality cost of products is the important part of the total cost. Quality cost include the internal and external failure costs, and preventing and identifying cost. The reject and rework cost is the most important part of internal and external failure costs. concentrate Because of preventing and identifying cost can be quantification easily, traditional companies usually are used to control these costs and ignore internal and external failure costs which is brought about by the no value-added activities such as reject and rework in the manufacturing process. We analyzed reject and rework costs based on products dimension chain and established a cost model of internal failure. Then based on product features, considering cost models, we analyzed the impact of key process against the cost and proposed a stratified quality control idea. Finally a program was designed to simulate this process by using VB 6.0.

articleTitle: Development of Sports Engineering Discipline in Wuhan Sports University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The sports engineering discipline has unique and clear research orientations and complete talent development system. What's more, the discipline has the key lab of sports engineering of the General Administration of Sport of China. The paper summerizes the sports engineering discipline development in the Wuhan Sports University and discusses its future development trend.

articleTitle: The Comparative Analysis on the Corporeity Supervision Results of Kids from 3-6 Years Old
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: the present study adopts the research method of spot check and does an analysis on 14 body indexes of boys and girls from 3 to 6 years old, including body build, function, quality and ect. The results are as follows: generally speaking, kids in kindergarten of Urumqi that are up the grade account for 88%, which is 2% higher than the average in Xinjiang but 1.2% lower than the average of China. In the above result, the excellent ones take up 9.8%, which is 0.5% higher than the average in Xinjiang but 1.4% lower than the average of China, the average ones take up 23.8%, which is 0.3% higher than that of Xinjiang but 1.4% lower than that of China, people who fail to pass the grade account for 11.2%, 2% lower than that of Xinjaing but 1.2% higher than that of China. The above results present the growing rules, development trend, differences and reasons of body indexes of kids in Urumqi, which provide some scientific base for the studies on kids' corporeity and its evaluation standards.

articleTitle: Research on PE Lab Construction and Development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the development of society and college PE department, PE lab has played a more and more important role in developing students' analysis and problem-solving abilities as well as hand-on skills. Therefore, PE lab shoulders the arduous and significant task of training adaptable PE talents who obtain both innovative and practical capabilities. By means of documentary, interview, questionnaire and logic analysis, this article has done a systematic research and analysis on PE labs in 30 colleges and universities throughout the country and revealed the problems existing in the PE lab construction and development. Then constructive suggestions were put forward to promote PE lab construction and development.

articleTitle: Study on Construction of College Physical Department Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Construction of laboratories is essential in promoting students' practical abilities, cultivating students' innovative capabilities and sense of scientific research. It restricts the quality of education and standard of science. Although some achievements have been made in constructing college physical department laboratories, shortages like outdated contents, laggard education skills and weak personnel still exist among most laboratories. This study combines practice and related articles, address that the construction of college physical department laboratories should be established on the basis of increasing the cognition of its importance and improving the standard of hard-ware, to innovate experiment teaching, improve construction of experimental team, establish open mind and innovate management methods, to better meet the needs of personnel training, and help for "National Fitness Program" and "Credit to the Olympic program".

articleTitle: The Grey Weight Analysis of the Influencing Factors in 400m Performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The methods of documentary data collecting, mathematical statistics as well as the grey weight analysis in the grey theory system are used to analyze the influencing factors in the 400m performance. Results indicate that: the time used in the first and fourth 100m of the race exerts great influence for the final result. Therefore, the training method needs to be improved in order to raise the competitiveness of the sport achievements, in particular the training in the first and fourth 100m period should be strengthened. So this paper will provide some information and suggestions for the coaches to guide players how to train in a scientific and reasonable way as well as improving the training methods.

articleTitle: Study on Network System of Intelligent Family Based on Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Along with the improvement of substance life level, the whole society will be greatly influenced by the development and application of the home net technology. The emergence of information appliances and the development of home network technology hasten the implement of intelligent and networking home. According to the state of the art of home network, being presented the home network platform and gateway, the network system of intelligent family based on Ethernet will complete the intelligentized management and control of equipment at home, further more, combining with gateway and internet, the system will bring the new habitation for the people.

articleTitle: Study on Lumbar Rotated and Localized Manipulation on Stress Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The thesis established the three-dimensional, comprehensive and realistic finite element model(FEM) of lumbar spine (L4-L5) using datum of Dicom with reverse engineering software, which incorporated the geometric, material and contact non-linearities was used for studying the biomechanics of a lumbar motion segment under flexion ad extension, whose structure is comprehensive, its meshing of elements is accurate. The results were following as: The maximum stress concentrated on the pedicle and the vertebral arch, as well as the bottom of the upper vertebrae facet joint, and the stress on the below joint the left is higher than the right side of the joints. The displacement gradually increased in all structures of vertebral body, the maximum displacement appears on the left side of edge on the L4 and the left side of upper joints and spinous process of L4. The stress is mainly concentrated in the disc annulus, stress on the left anterior lateral is biggest, stress on right posterior lateral is small, the stress gradually increased. The displacement and stress on the intervertebral disc changes in the same direction, which concentrated in the annulus, the displacement on the left side is higher than that of the right side. The three-dimensional FEM could be used for studying the biomechanics of a lumbar spine to diagnose and treat the trauma and disease of lumbar spine.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Xinjiang Tourism E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The rapid development of e-commerce is a great opportunity for Xinjiang tourism. Based on an objective analysis of the status quo of Xinjiang Tourism e-commerce, I find that Xinjiang is rich in its Tourism resources, but the conditions for developing Tourism e-commerce are not satisfactory. The general environment for developing Tourism e-commerce is not satisfactory and compound talent is badly needed. Consequently, countermeasures are proposed in this article.

articleTitle: The Problems and Solutions for Laboratory Team Construction in Sport Institutes
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The laboratory construction in sport institutes is the foundation for P.E. majors in regular institutions of higher learning, which can help ensuring the teaching quality and improving the ability of scientific research, and can be regarded as the material platform of enforcing the quality and innovation education. It is urgently needed to improve the traditional physical experimental teaching system and mode to cultivate innovative and applied talents. In this thesis, problems of experiment laboratory construction in sport institute are studied, using the methods of documentary data, expert interview, comparative analysis and so on. Basing on the presenting of experimental teaching and research status quo, the development tendencies of sport laboratory construction under the new circumstances are mentioned. The conclusion is that the main problems existing in sport special laboratory construction are the lagging and poor management system, inflexible and slow operation mechanism, low utilization of resources and the aging corps of technician. The thesis puts forward the solutions on how to strengthen the understanding of laboratory construction, reform the management system, strengthen the team building, construct the new system of experimental teaching, and create a new network communication platform of laboratory construction etc..

articleTitle: Risk Management and Audit for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The risks for E-commerce include both technology risk and moral hazard. Information technology such as Internet is the core factor influencing the development of E-commerce. However, technology risk is a big threat for the application of information technology. In this paper, the technology risks are divided into 4 parts which are the risk form hackers, peep, structural defects on information infrastructure for E-commerce and the drawbacks of the information system for companies. Besides, moral hazard is comprised of repudiation, fake web pages, privacy violation and accuracy of information. Audit is an important method for risk management for E-commerce. This article applies the external and internal audit to management the risk in E-commerce.

articleTitle: Effect of the Structure of University's R&D Funds on the Outcome of Invention Patents in Jiang Su Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The university's invention patents are always brought out during the process of science research, which relies on various funds. Government investment is the main source of college research funds. This paper analyzes the relationship of the number of college invention patents authorized of Jangsu Province from 1997-2007 and the structure of government R&D funds, in order to figure out the effect of different funds on the invention patents, then ultimately put forward effective suggestions for improvement.

articleTitle: Research on the Silk Road Tourism Development from the Perspective of Tourist Destination
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: After the Trade Road, Culture Gallery and Traffic Road, the Silk Road will be a bright tourist route in the world map in the 21st century. At present, the Silk Road Tourism has started, however, there are a series of problems, such as weak awareness, inconvenient traffic, inadequate investment, repetitious construction, disorder management and competition. Blessed with beautiful natural scene, long history, profound culture and rich ethnic flavor, it will surely become a global top tourist destination as long as the market orientation is proper, government takes the leading role and enterprises actively participate.

articleTitle: Analyses on the Front Problem of Sports Science in the World
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Research on the articles published on world leading technology journal articles in recent three years, this paper analyzes hot issues and difficult problems in the field of world sports science, and concluded a brief overview of its research progress. Four areas of current research findings are focused on: gene and training, skeletal muscle, connective tissue and bone dynamics, muscle stem cells. On this basis, considering technology and levels of domestic research, research emphases of China's current sports science and importance to the development of competitive sports are going to be put forward.

articleTitle: Research for Building to Evaluation Indicators System of Technological Innovation in Urban Area
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Observing the principle of systematicness, scientificity, feasibility and comparability, a evaluation indicators system for technological innovation in urban area was built. The evaluation indicators system is operable and practical, it is used to evaluate the level of technological innovation in urban area.

articleTitle: The Construction and Practice of Modern Distance Physical Education Network Resource
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the developing of computer network technology, the popularizing of computer in college and the increasing demand of continuing education in society, The modern distance education which based on net become the main trend and direction of high educational reform. Based on modern distance education fast information dissemination ability, excellent resources sharing, the advanced performance two-way interaction and multimedia technology, constructing university physical education curriculum distance network resource is the traditional sports supplement and development, which plays an active role in China's physical education. the resource of physical network courses opens up a new teaching environment to students, expands the teaching time and space, breaks the traditional teacher-student relationship, which make for the continuation physical education and lifelong physical education. College physical education should give full play to its own characteristics and advantages, applying modern education technology and network technology to promote teaching reform, adapts the social development request.

articleTitle: The Study on the Merit Combination Application of the Teaching Method of Skating and Speed Skating
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Through expert interviews, experiments and mathematical statistical method, such as motor skills of skating and speed skating migration research, and applied to college teaching skating and speed skating, improve teaching quality. The purpose is to promote the teaching of the reform and development.

articleTitle: Study on Effects of Career Women Fitness Motivation and Fitness
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: with the use of "career women Fitness Motivation Scale, " "Subjective Well-Being Scale" , author checked career women's fitness test the motives and subjective well-being, and tested their body compositions. The results showed that: motivation of Occupational women participating in fitness is mainly for exercise to physical needs, the esthetic needs and the psychological adjustment of a demand-led, the of trend their psychological need is strengthening. It is difficult to find a obvious effect among different sports and exercises after years of fitness training to improve body composition, suggesting that the design of study on the effects of physical exercise should be based on science and health guidance, and take Continuious study of before and after exercise as the dominant ideology.

articleTitle: Forecasting the RMB Exchange Regime
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: To resolve the slow convergence and local minimum problem of BP network, an exchange rate forecast method based on Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN) is proposed. Data on economic variables is normalized, and then is put into the RBFNN in training. Corresponding parameters are got and then the exchange rate is predicted. Detailed simulation results and comparisons with Back-Propagation (BP) network show that, the operation speed of the method is faster and the forecast accuracy is higher than the traditional BP neural network can be achieved obviously. We then use genetic programming approach to achieve a better outcome compared with ANN.

articleTitle: Research on WebGIS-based Crisis Management System for Venues of Major Games
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Crisis management plays an important role for us to host major sports games successfully. With the help of the technologies of WebGIS, a prototype of crisis management information system is developed for the 11th national sports game venues. It combines with data collection, management, analysis, early warning, and decision-making with the highly efficient mechanism of inquiries and intelligent analysis. This prototype can be a direct important reference for the future big sports games and events.

articleTitle: The Static Balance Stability's Biomechanics Research on Youth Trampolinists
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Using the German Zebris measuring systems for plantar force distribution to measure the youth trampolinists' static balance stability who attended the National Youth Trampoline Championship, Guilin, Guangxi from the 18th--23th of November 2009. We got 6 balance parameters results which are ellipse's width, height, area, track length, horizontal offset and vertical offset. Using these 6 parameters for comparing the differences of balance stability when youth trampolinists eyes open stand on both feet with closed and eyes open stand on single foot with closed. Through this way to discuss the features of trampolinists' static balance performance and provide a theoretical basis for trampolinists' scientific athlete selection and training.

articleTitle: The Advantage of Rock-Climbing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This article utilizes the literature material method, the logical analytic method, carries on the induction, the deduction to the advantage of Rock-Climbing, and brings in the spiritual encouragement for the general Rock-Climbing amateur as well as the Rock-Climbing athletics athlete. Through from many angles to the rock-climbing movement's analysis, promotion more and more people participates in this movement.

articleTitle: Consonant Passwords in the Fingers (2)
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The first Robot was born in America in 1962, from then on people were hoping to manufacture an Intelligent Robots. People endowed the Robots with the Artificial Intelligence before the Intelligent Science come into the world, the Robots can only achieve vague control and simulation control. People are needed to break through in the Intelligent Science in order to achieve precise control due to the infinite possibilities. Talking with others is a process of language flowing, at least the Chinese Alphabet can be located in the fingers. The 15 consonant passwords will be only discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Web Search Based on Cultural Algorithm New Framework
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: With the development of information technology, especially the widespread use of Web, information on Web increases rapidly and becomes a huge information resource. In the meanwhile, such abundant information makes it an urgent problem: how to extract useful content rapidly and efficiently from information resources. This paper proposes a framework for evolutionary systems to search implicit knowledge on the web. Based on Cultural Algorithms (CA), the web search process is supported by the domain knowledge objects in the belief space, and the optimization process is supported by evolutionary search in the population space. This framework in web search may help increase competition and diversity on the web.

articleTitle: Swarm Simulation Model of Multi-Agent Evolutionary Game in the Process of Product Innovation of Sports Goods Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: According to the think of multi-agent evolutionary game base on Swarm, the evolutionary game simulation model under incomplete information market is presented. The mode characterized the evolutionary game process in which corporation continually modifies its behavior rule using the obtained information. In the model, the need of the conventional products, products of self-directed innovation and imitation innovation products is decided on the demand of consumer is utility functions, the product quality and the price is. The model regards the latent competitors as a colony and corporations choose independent innovation or imitation innovation strategy can be treated a probability.

articleTitle: Control of Cell Morphology in Polypropylene Foaming
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In this paper, polypropylene foam was prepared by chemical extruded foaming, the effect of formulation and process conditions on properties of polypropylene foam was investigated. The results show that the main factor affecting polypropylene foam is the die temperature, when the screw temperature is 182°C, the die temperature is 153°C, screw speed is 20 rpm, the amount of foaming agent is 3.8 wt% and the amount of talc is 0.65 wt%, the cell size is uniform and the average number size can be controlled within 56 μm, the cell density is up to 7.13×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> cells/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Barrier-Free Electronic Height Instrument
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to give the testers a barrier-free environment and to encourage the use of run-up in the height test, we combine the mechanical rotating feeler with the electronic display, achieving a high degree of accurate measurement of touch. The height instrument introduced in this paper adopts ATMEGA16 AVR as the microcontroller to collect and process the data from the sensor rod, driving the digital display at the same time.

articleTitle: Develop the System of BJ-2 Combat Items Training and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In the boxing, free combat, kickboxing combat events, the attack speed, strength, explosive force, blow impulse etc is an important measured against attack effect and diagnostic technique indicators for players. The general fighting coaches, athletes are very eager to solve the major problem which how to analysis and evaluation the athletes technical of action by effectively obtain these indexes. Develop the system of BJ-2 combat items training and monitoring is based on this demand. This system can formulate scientific training plan, correct guidance and corrective action of athletes for coaches as an objective basis, through the determination of real-time combat athletes finish offensive actions of kinematics and dynamics, technical parameters, etc.

articleTitle: Estimate-Piloted Regularization and Fast ALS Algorithm for Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Regularized Low-rank approximation with missing data is an effective approach for Collaborative Filtering since it generates high quality rating predictions for recommender systems. Alternative LS (ALS) method is one of the commonly used algorithms for the CF problem. However, ALS did not work very well in some applications, due to the over-fitting to observations. This paper proposes a novel estimate-piloted regularization that uses a pre-estimate of the unobserved entries and uses the approximation errors to the pre-estimates as a regularize term. This new regularization can reduce the risk of over-fitting and improve the approximation accuracy of ALS. We also proposed a fast implementation of the modified ALS method, which is also very suitable for parallel computing. The proposed algorithm PALS has higher accuracy than ALS for original model in three real-world data sets.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Learning System of Sailing Rules Based on Flash Software
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The IT development brings more possibility of the combination of IT and sport. The development of sailing in China is in urgent needs of staff that is able to design the multimedia software. However, most of the supporting staff of sailing came from athletes before and they lacked the systematic learning of IT, thus it is difficult for them to design the multimedia courseware. The exploration of the learning system of sailing rules based on the flash software featured with great interaction and animation production can help improve the athletes' understanding of the sailing rules and the sailing in China.

articleTitle: The Study of CAI Courseware on Assisting the Basketball Experimental Course Teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to promote the teaching reform and innovation of Optional Courses of Physical Education, this paper applies CAI courseware, designed by combining with the characteristics of the basketball professional and technical courses, to experiment teaching in the experimental classes, and then compares the effect with the counterpart classes which adopts conventional teaching methods. The results showed that: there are significant difference in sports interest and student satisfaction when applied CAI courseware to assist the basketball teaching, while no so much difference in the conventional teaching, which indicated that the CAI courseware can improve students' effectiveness and student satisfaction of the basketball skill teaching much better.

articleTitle: The Preparation of Nano Cellulose Whiskers / Polylactic Acid Composites
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The purpose of this study was to prepare a kind of fully biodegradable nanocomposites for the sports industry. As a completely biological material, This material had not only special properties of nanomaterials, but also had the rigidity of cellulose, dimensional stability and fully biodegradable, at the same time, such material could also solve the disposal problem of waste sports equipment. With different mass fraction, cellulose nano whiskers were added to the polylactic acid matrix, and the composites were prepared by solution casting method, then nano-cellulose whiskers / polylactic acid composites were successfully made. Tests were carried out to study the water absorption, degradation and membrane mechanical properties of the composites. Compared with the pure polylactic acid, water absorption and degradation of the composites increased significantly with the mass fraction of nano-cellulose whiskers increasing. Compared with pure PLA film, the tensile strength and elongation at break of composite membranes increased significantly. When the CNW mass fraction was at 5% maximum, the mechanical properties of nanocomposite got its maximum value. By solution casting, Nano-cellulose whiskers and polylactic acid matrix successfully were prepared into nanocomposites, which had excellent mechanical properties and very good performance at biological degradation.

articleTitle: Discussion on Legal Regulation Problem of ROSCA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: "ROSCA" is the non-governmental financing mutual aid organization form with oriental tradition. As a folk custom it has a long history and practice in China. However, the current legal system doesn't establish the legal status of ROSCA in China, leading to in different regions and periods, although ROSCA as the financing way in rural areas and small and medium-sized enterprises becomes increasingly intense, it can't get unified and efficient supervision and has frequent risks. Besides the absence of legislation, there are rare theory studies of ROSCA. Under this background, this paper will discuss from the characteristics of ROSCA, and discuss the risk of ROSCA and the importance of its legal regulation, and proposes the reference suggestion how to characterize it in legal norm.

Author Keywords: Bidding Rotating Savings and Credit Associations

articleTitle: Realization of Virtual Scene Multiuser's Connection Technology on LAN
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Distributed network of network communication raised new demands: first, how to collect each computer to accurate real-time data to the entire network all the computers for their monitoring, secondly, how the historical data to the whole Each computer network to ensure a consistent whole network data, In addition, how will a computer control command issued to the implementation of the right machine, and control records to the whole network of other computers. This paper designs and implements a virtual scene in the distributed network multiplayer system, an online multi-user virtual environment to achieve the mutual information between the data and send and receive and transmit.

articleTitle: Designing and Implementing Sanda Scoring System Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: At present, referees award marks manually for candidates in Sanda enrollment competetion in china, which has many disadvantages. The Sanda scoring system introduced here uses computer communication technology to connect multiple devices into a wireless network, and proceeds data management and output on PC. Adopting of this system will improve greatly the accuracy and efficiency of enrollment competions, prevent cheating and reduce human error probability. Furthermore, it can be extended to other sports games after some modifications. This article introduces the hardware connection of ARM9 processor S3C2416, AT043TN24 LCD and Zigbee wireless transport, presents the software implementation of intelligent marking devices, then elaborates the achievement process of the upper computer function in the system.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Cycling Specific Timing System Based on Wireless Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This essay introduces a specific speed timing system used in cycling, which was built by the skill of electrommunication, network communication and database technology. In this system, a wireless real-time timer technique was adopted and communication master station was used. As a result, timing data can be real-time transmitted, stored and analyzed. Owing to the special-used hardware and software, various functions, such as setting up single or multiple timing device network, split time data and to al time data acquisition, data gathering, data exhibition, data inquiring, data storing and data analysis, can be achieved. The use of the system can help coaches solve the problem on dealing with the data, which could be great helpful in improving work efficiency. This system is useful for not only cycling, but also for other kinds of sports needing timed, such as swimming, track and field, Modern Pentathlon and skating.

articleTitle: A Survey Research on the Career Planning of Physical Education Majors in Sichuan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Sichuan province is an important area where having trained physical education teachers of elementary school and high school in China. The graduations of physical education majors encountered difficulties in hunting jobs in recent years. The course of career planning is an important part of the colleges' curriculum and would solve the employment problem. The paper had questionnaire surveyed of 600 students in 5 colleges in Sichuan province. And the result is the of part-time and internship characteristics of diversity and non-clear purpose; the channel of career consultation is narrow; students want better to get the job of promising; students have an ambiguous professional orientation and the planning cannot be corrected in time.

articleTitle: Construction of Teaching Integrable Ware in Sports Statistics Course
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: The application of teaching integrable ware, with its measures and steps of construction in sports statistics, with the characteristics of sports statistics, can not only inspire the interest in sports statistics and train the comprehensive quality, but also achieve the process of teaching and learning and obtain a better teaching effect.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Wireless Environmental Monitoring System Based on ZigBee for Stadium
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to improve comfort of stadium for sportsman and audience, this paper propose a solution to Stadium Environment detection system based on ZigBee. End Device responsible for data collection and send data to Coordinator through wireless network. Coordinator received data from end device and sent it to computer through a serial port.

articleTitle: Research of Mining Algorithm Based on 1NF Strongly Correlated Item Pair
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: In order to reduce the computation cost of candidate pairs, we have developed the Taper algorithm according to 1NF property. The developed TaperR algorithm can cut the number of candidate pairs to improve efficiency. Experimental results exhibit that the new algorithm is well-worked in the mining of all-strong-pairs. So it is more suitable for real relation database system.

articleTitle: Development and Problem on the Research Innovative Ability Building of Undergraduate of Science and Technology Major in the Physical Institute and University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By analyzing of the international research Innovative ability building mode of undergraduate domestic and overseas, it's discussed of the problem about the research innovative ability building of undergraduate of science and technology major in the physical institute and university. It's found that the undergraduates majoring in science and technology are involved in scientific research in the physical institute and universities and it has a breakthrough both in scale and method, in general, in our country physical institute and universities, the development mode featured with undergraduate majoring in science involved in scientific research isn't popular, is lack of systematization and continuity, and it is not set as a rule, Compared with other comprehensive universities, the resources for innovative practice which are provided by the majority of physical institutes and universities are still insufficient. Through this research project, this article hopes to provide reference to design the research innovative ability development mode of undergraduate of science and technology in the physical institute and universities.

articleTitle: The Construction of Physical Monitoring Model of Adults in Shijiazhang, Hebei
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: By using the method of factor analysis and regression analysis, the national physical data of 2000 and 2005 were disposed by SPSS13.0 software (the national physical data of 2010 is unknown now) and the physical monitoring model of the adult in Shijiazhuang was established by taking the physical data of male from 20 to 25 years old as an example. The national physical condition of adults in Shijiazhuang was compared between 2000 and 2005 based on this model.

articleTitle: Researches on Combinations of Auxiliary Problems in ASO (Alternating Structure Optimization) Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: Recently, a semi-supervised learning algorithm called ASO (Alternating Structure Optimization) has been proposed, which belongs to linear structural learning. It utilizes a number of auxiliary problems (APs) with unlabelled data and then extracts common structural parameter of APs to improve the performances of the target problems (TPs). How to select the appropriate APs is the keystone of ASO algorithm. This paper proposes another principle of APs selection: combinations. It determines optimal ratios between multi-combinations when proper total amounts of APs are given. Besides, we also analyze how to select appropriate total amounts. Both theoretical analysis and experimental results indicate that the principle of combinations is credible. Comparing with the principle of diversity that we have proposed, this principle immensely reduces the computational complexity. While the performances keep invariable.

articleTitle: Design and Application of the E-Learning Network Platform of China National Sailing Team
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Future Computer Science and Education
abstract: This thesis based on sustainable development of sailing sport in China. The starting point is the reality of particularity of sailing, the mental training and culture learning for athletes. And bring Moodle distance education software into the National Sailing Team, in order to establish a powerful network education system which starts from existing culture level of the athletes, with vivid learning process, provides concise and easy way to learn. Through this education platform, athletes can learn the knowledge what they need anytime, anywhere, and in this way to improve the level of their intelligence and technical, finally improve their comprehensive competitiveness in the race.
